## What this changes

## Why

Link the OpenSpec change or the issue this closes, for example `Closes #123`.

## Evidence

- [ ] `make verify` is green: lint, types, API tests and the browser suite
- [ ] The change's `acceptance.md` maps each scenario to its evidence
- [ ] Contracts regenerated if the API boundary moved, and the diff reviewed

## Boundaries

Say what the change does not cover, and which parts of the evidence come from simulated boundaries rather than a live run.

## Checklist

- [ ] One observable behavior per change
- [ ] Every commit carries the DCO sign off (`git commit -s`)
- [ ] No secret, no private snapshot, no personal path added
- [ ] Localized text lives in the FR and EN catalogs
